note: Fixed-price bundles of a catalog unit plus panels. Prices are entered here by hand from the verified catalog (kits.json, checked live 2026-10-05; docs/solar-calculator/VERIFY-market.md) so the app never parses prices out of free-text notes. 'base' must exist in kits.json; 'panels.catalogId' names the matching loose-panel entry.
